My lorde of Caunteberries
Brothe for a Consumptione
Take like as before sauinge put thereto a handfull of violett leaues
langdebeefe leaues Borrage leaues and Strawberrie leaues, knit
togeather of euerie one alike quantitye.

ffor the pyles
Take one handfull of mollet leaues, and wrappe them in a Colewort
leafe, and rake them in the [Imbers?] vntill they bee well rested
then take them, and pull awaye the Coleworte leafe, and grinde
them in a mortar, and put to yt oyle of roses, and grinde them togeather
then take it and laye it to the pyles withe a trusser, and vse this
morninge and euenynge.

ffor the flixe
Take horsedounge new made and frie it withe sweete butter,
and put it in a clothe and laye it to the fundament, as hott
as you maye suffer ytt, and sit vppen vntill you haue ease.

ffor Disties
Take blacke woole whiche growes vpon the flanke
of a sheepe and tarre, and mingell them togeather
and putt them into the eare.

My Lorde of Cannterberries
Brothe for a Consumptione
Take like as before sauinge putt thereto a handfull of voilett leaues
langdebeeffe leaues Buorrage leaues and strawberrie leaues, knitt
togeather of euerie one alike quantitye.
For the pyles
Takeone handefull of mollett leaues, and wrappe them in a Colewort
leafe, and rake them in the Imbers vntill they bee well rosted.
then take them, and putt awaye the Coleworte leafe, and grinde
them in a morter, and putt to ytt oyle of roses, and grinde them togeather
then take itt and laye itt to the pyles withe a trusser, and use this
moreninge and euenynde.
For the Flixe
Take horsedounge new made and frie itt withe sweete butter.
and putt itt in a clothe and laye itt to the fundamente. as hott
as yow maye suffer ytt, and sitte uppon untill yow haue ease.
For Deffnes
Take blacke woole, whiche growes vppon the flanke
of a sheepe and tarre, and mingell them togeath[er]
and putt them into the eare.
